messages:
Ava Patel: Morning — saw a big overnight jump in the low-priority GPU pool (pool: lp-gpu-west). Need help attributing it, looks like multiple teams hit burst limits. cc @Jon Reyes and @Priya Nair

Jon Reyes: Yep saw the alert. Cost dashboard shows a +3.2x step at 03:12 UTC. Any idea which billing IDs are involved? :thinking_face:

cost-bot: ALERT: Unusual spend detected for resource `lp-gpu-west` — +320% vs baseline. Top tags: `team:unknown`, `env:prod?`, `project:unlabeled`. Link: https://console.redwood/costs/alert/2493

Priya Nair: I can run a quick attribution query. Can you paste the sample row from the billing export? or I can pull last 24h by pool and tag key.

Ava Patel: here's the sample from Snowflake extract (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z,lp-gpu-west,n1-highmem-8,project_id=proj-*,labels.team=,labels.owner=,charge=1823.45
```

Jon Reyes: Labels.team empty — that's the problem. We had a billing pipeline change last week that switched tag key `team` -> `owner_team` for some infra-created instances. Finance breakdown still expects `labels.team`.

Priya Nair: Ack. That explains the `team:unknown` blob. I can backfill by mapping `owner_team` -> `team` for charges where `labels.team` is blank. Quick SQL I plan to run: 
```
UPDATE billing_flat
SET team = COALESCE(team, owner_team)
WHERE pool = 'lp-gpu-west' AND usage_ts >= '2026-03-15';
```

Jon Reyes: Before you run it, can we instead dump the affected rows and review? Need to avoid overwriting any intentionally blank fields for external customers.

Ava Patel: Good call. Dump sounds fine. Also question: do we have budget alerts that should have fired earlier? Finance didn't get paged until morning.

cost-bot: INFO: Budget threshold for `lp-gpu-west` set to 2x baseline, alerting channel #infra-costs. Alert sent at 03:18 UTC to #infra-costs.

Priya Nair: I exported the affected rows to S3: s3://redwood-costs/tmp/attr-2493001234.csv — includes billing_id, instance_id, owner_team, account_id, charge_usd. I will DM the link to Jon and Ava.

Jon Reyes: Received. Quick scan shows ~60% of the spike is account `acct-playground` and ~25% is `acct-devcore` with owner_team mostly blank for older VMs. Looks like playground experiments triggered long-running preemptible jobs overnight.

Ava Patel: ok can we do two things: 1) backfill mapping where safe; 2) create a temporary reallocation so finance can tag the cost to `playground` vs `devcore` for March 15th charges and issue a small internal credit to dev if misattributed.

Priya Nair: For (1) I'll produce a proposal SQL and post it here. For (2) finance will need a manual redistribution entry in the ledger — Jon?

Jon Reyes: I can handle the ledger reallocation once we have the final CSV with `billing_id, old_team, new_team, amount_usd, rationale`. Send to me and I'll process the journal entry. Also recommend we add a temporary alert to page on >150% baseline for `lp-gpu-west` overnight window (00:00-06:00 UTC).

Ava Patel: agree on the temp alert. Priya, can you also add a short playbook snippet so on-call knows to check `owner_team` vs `team` tag mismatch next time? 1-2 steps only.

Priya Nair: Will do. Draft playbook: 1) run `SELECT owner_team, team, sum(charge_usd) ... GROUP BY owner_team, team` 2) if `team` is null and owner_team present -> map and notify finance 3) if unknown account -> set temp budget throttle. I'll paste the snippet in infra runbook repo after review.

Jon Reyes: One more ask — can we add an annotation in billing UI recording this as "tagging-migration mismatch" so future audits won't re-open? If infra can't annotate, finance will add a note to the March billing folder.

Ava Patel: Great. Priya, after you dump the proposed backfill rows, flag anything that looks like external customer traffic (acct prefix `cust-*`) and we'll exclude from auto-mapping.

Priya Nair: Will filter for `cust-*`. Targeting to post the CSV + SQL proposal in this thread in 30m.

Ava Patel: Thanks — appreciate the fast triage. :pray:

cost-bot: REMINDER: follow-up check scheduled +24h for alert 2493.

infra-ops-bot: Deployment note: tag migration rollout v2026.03.14 included `owner_team` key; team agreed to finish compatibility shim by 2026-03-18. Rolling back shim not recommended."
